arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
src = open('offline_discovery/rule_remove.py').read()
old = src[src.index("def _coverage(sub, prefix, labels, bounds, classes, length):"):src.index("def calibrate(bounds_list, rows, classes):")]
new = '''def _coverage(sub, prefix, labels, bounds, classes, length):
    """Validation rows holding at least one window inside every interval.

    Coordinate zero is scanned over the whole row window matrix. Sparse results
    continue as an index list (cheap when intervals are selective), dense
    results stay boolean (avoids a large nonzero extraction).
    """
    rows = sub.shape[0]
    possible = np.ones(rows, dtype=bool)
    for axis in range(length):
        lo, hi = bounds[axis]
        possible &= prefix[hi+1] != prefix[lo]
    chosen = np.nonzero(possible)[0]
    if chosen.size == 0:
        return [0]*classes
    block = sub if chosen.size == rows else sub[chosen]
    picked = labels if chosen.size == rows else labels[chosen]
    window = block.shape[1]-length+1
    lo, hi = bounds[0]
    candidate = (block[:, 0:window] >= lo) & (block[:, 0:window] <= hi)
    if length == 1:
        hit = candidate.any(axis=1)
    else:
        total = int(np.count_nonzero(candidate))
        if total == 0:
            return [0]*classes
        if total > 2*block.shape[0]:
            for axis in range(1, length):
                lo, hi = bounds[axis]
                candidate &= (block[:, axis:axis+window] >= lo) & \\
                             (block[:, axis:axis+window] <= hi)
                if not candidate.any():
                    return [0]*classes
            hit = candidate.any(axis=1)
        else:
            row_index, offset = np.nonzero(candidate)
            for axis in range(1, length):
                lo, hi = bounds[axis]
                values = block[row_index, offset+axis]
                keep = (values >= lo) & (values <= hi)
                row_index = row_index[keep]
                offset = offset[keep]
                if row_index.size == 0:
                    return [0]*classes
            hit = np.zeros(block.shape[0], dtype=bool)
            hit[row_index] = True
    if not hit.any():
        return [0]*classes
    return np.bincount(picked[hit], minlength=classes).tolist()


'''
open('offline_discovery/rule_remove.py','w').write(src.replace(old, new))
